title: STEAM-IE FOR HYDROPONICS
subtitle: A practical guide for building and running a small hydroponic greenhouse in Addis Ababa.
author: Prof. Frehun A. Demissie

cover.note: One concept per page, ordered across the seven letters of STEAM-IE.

lines: Set in Space Grotesk, Inter and JetBrains Mono.
Built with the paper engine: github.com/hassancs91/paper-engine

parts.name: Science
parts.why: Before you grow anything in water, understand how plants actually drink and eat.

parts.name: Technology
parts.why: The tools that replace what nature does for free, and that you can buy in Merkato.

parts.name: Engineering
parts.why: The frame, the racks, and the pipes that hold the whole system up.

parts.name: Arts
parts.why: A greenhouse that is well laid out is a greenhouse people want to work in.

parts.name: Mathematics
parts.why: The numbers tell you, before you spend the money, whether this will pay back.

parts.name: Innovation
parts.why: What you swap, rebuild, or reinvent to make this work with what you can find in Addis.

parts.name: Entrepreneurship
parts.why: The science is wasted if no one buys what you grow. This is where the harvest becomes a business.
